boundary_rule: Start inclusive, end exclusive; timestamps have no supplied timezone.
selection_reason: Main benchmark covers dense September 1-10 activity. September 11-18 has sparse activity and a sharply different label rate in the full-file audit, so it is retained as a separate tail evaluation.
scope: Split creation only. No resampling, duplicate removal, feature fitting, or training.
currency_policy: Original currency strings retained. No exchange conversion applied.
account_identity: Use (bank, account) pairs; transaction IDs are not model features.
target: label is derived from Is Laundering; never use it as a predictor.
ordered_read: SELECT * FROM transactions ORDER BY timestamp, transaction_id
history_rule: History features must use events strictly earlier than each scored timestamp. A transaction_id tie-break is only for reproducible output; it does not establish causal order among same-time events. Fit transforms on training rows only.
evaluation_rule: Tune on validation only. Reserve test and tail labels for final evaluation. Report tail results separately; do not pool them into the main headline metrics.
